locations.label: Power switch
locations.description: Reach the power room at the far end of the upper floor and activate the switch. The dividing spawn door opens and the perk machines and electric traps become usable. Reunite through the now-open connection before making the next round harder. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Jugger-Nog starting side
locations.description: Jugger-Nog and Quick Revive mark the two starting sides; Double Tap and Speed Cola lie along the upstairs circuit. In solo, Quick Revive costs 500 and provides up to three self-revives. In co-op it speeds up revives instead. Double Tap increases fire rate; it is not Double Tap II. Mule Kick is available with the BO1 title update. There is no Pack-a-Punch route on this map. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
